title_zh: 具有保护约束的周期时频冲突消解模型
abstract_zh: 本校样用于检验统一源稿件的可编辑公式与双格式排版能力。模型内容、公式和验证条件取自作者现有数学模型稿；排版验收不构成数学正确性验证。
title_en: A periodic time-frequency conflict resolution model
abstract_en: This proof checks content preservation and editable mathematics in the author's model draft. Typesetting acceptance does not establish mathematical correctness.
